Company Description

Fixture Robotics builds autonomous material-handling robots for warehouses and factories. Our fleet moves millions of parts every day for customers across North America.

Job Description

As a Field Applications Engineer you will lead on-site deployments, train customer operators, and turn field feedback into product improvements together with our robotics software team.

You will travel to customer sites, commission robot fleets, tune navigation maps, and troubleshoot hardware and network integrations.

Qualifications

  • BS in Mechanical, Electrical or Computer Engineering
  • 3+ years in customer-facing engineering
  • Comfortable with Linux, networking and Python scripting

Additional Information

Fixture Robotics is an equal opportunity employer.
